scientific_integrity: The input simplex covariogram identity and the two-point-distance covariogram representation are established literature, not claimed as original. The claimed contribution is the exact first Euclidean-radius clipping branch and its dimension-dependent singularity for all simplices of dimension at least three.
scientific_limitations: Does not give the complete distance CDF after the first cap-overlap or submaximal-normal threshold. The coefficient moments are represented by explicit finite spherical integrals, not asserted to have a universal elementary closed form. Historical priority has not been independently certified.
title: Exact first Euclidean-distance transition for arbitrary simplices
